agent.downHint: This window shows what the agent reports; without it there is no link and no sync.

role.listener: This machine receives the peer's keyboard and mouse
role.dialer: This machine shares its keyboard and mouse with the peer

peers.subtitle: The machines on your tailnet. The link goes to the marked one.

folders.subtitle: Folders kept the same on both machines, paired by name.
folders.offeredShort: The other side offers {n} folder(s) this machine lacks.
folders.offeredHint: Pick where it lives on this machine; the name must match on both sides.
folders.peerAway: The peer is not connected: folders wait for it.
folders.removeBody: No file is touched on either side. The folder just leaves the sync.
folders.deletesBody: If these deletions are the ones you meant, confirm. They go to the trash, as every deletion does.
folders.nameHint: The name pairs this folder with the other side's. Use the same on both machines.
folders.noPreview: The preview appears once the other side has the folder too.
folders.conflicts: {n} file(s) on both sides with different content
folders.conflictsHint: Both versions stay: the newer under the original name, the other named after its machine.
folders.divergent: {n} git repositor(ies) that differ on both sides
folders.divergentHint: Merging file by file would break a repository. Pick a side for each, and the opposite on the other machine; what loses goes to the trash.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.hint: Nothing blocked leaves here or comes in from the other side. Without a slash it matches the name anywhere (node_modules, *.env); a path starts with ~ or /.
blocks.builtInHint: Keys, keyrings, browser profiles, the system and system junk. They stay.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Everything the sync deleted or overwrote, kept for 30 days.
trash.takenBody: {path} exists now. Restoring anyway sends the current one to the trash.

settings.subtitle: This machine's settings. They apply at once.
settings.edgeHint: The border of this screen the peer's screen sits beyond.
settings.portHint: The link uses this port; folder sync the next one.

help.clipboard: What you copy on one side pastes on the other.

audio.playback: This machine's sound plays on the peer's speakers, and these stay muted.
audio.mic: Not built yet: the peer's microphone as an input here.
